basic_info.description: Rare Opportunity - Triplex set on an expansive 5,600+ square foot lot in the heart of Lower Pacific Heights.  2742-2744 Sutter Street offers timeless architecture, flexible use, and exceptional potential. This three-unit building features beautiful wood floors, soaring ceilings, and period details that speak to San Francisco's architectural heritage.  Two units are currently vacant, great for an owner-occupier or market-rate rental while the tenant-occupied unit generates strong ongoing income. Whether you're seeking a smart investment, a multi-generational living solution, or a property to reimagine over time, this is a rare find on a large parcel in a premier location.
